signIn.heading: Sign in to your space.
signIn.invalidCredentials: This email address and this password do not go together. Check them, then try again.
signIn.locked: Too many attempts: your account is locked for a while. Come back a little later, or choose a new password.
signIn.noAccount: This account has no access here. Sign in with the address your invitation was sent to.
newPassword.rulesUnmet: Your password does not follow every rule yet.
setPassword.heading: Choose your password.
setPassword.lead: With your email address, it opens your space from any device.
setPassword.label: Your password
resetPassword.heading: Choose a new password.
resetPassword.lead: It replaces the old one: you will sign in with it from now on.
resetPassword.label: Your new password
expiredLink.heading: This link no longer works.
expiredLink.lead: It was already used, or it expired. Ask for a new one: it comes by email.
forgotPassword.heading: Forgot your password?
forgotPassword.lead: Enter the email address of your account: we send you a link to choose a new password.
forgotPassword.sentLead: If an account matches {email}, a link to choose a new password is waiting in your mailbox.
mailbox.heading: Check your mailbox.
mailbox.help: Nothing after a few minutes? Check your spam folder.
verifyEmail.lead: We sent a link to {email}. Open it to confirm your address.
